personality_one_liner: A pristine, iOS-native food delivery experience featuring warm sand surfaces, crisp typography, and high-intent culinary discovery.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with iOS-native padding rhythms and sticky lower-third primary CTAs.

do's: Use translucent frosted glass for sticky headers and bottom tab bars over scrolling content
Pair blur with ≥70% tinted surface base for guaranteed contrast
dont's: Never blur form fields or body text regions
Avoid glass on dense data tables where clarity beats aesthetics

states.loading: Checking secure session and loading config...

screens.name: Onboarding

screens.name: Help and Support
screens.purpose: Customer support FAQ and instant live chat ticket creation for order issues.
screens.layout: Top search bar for help topics, collapsible FAQ accordion categories, and 'Chat with Us' banner.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete React Native Expo customer food delivery app connecting to the Node.js Express MongoDB backend.
Ensure all 23 screens requested in the problem statement are fully implemented, navigable via Expo Router, and include loading, empty, and error states.
Strictly follow iOS-Native Clean personality with warm sand surfaces (#FDFBF7), terracotta brand accents (#D95325), and Geist/Plus Jakarta Sans typography.
Never use indigo, violet, purple, or navy blue. Use near-black text on warm sand surfaces.
Implement real logo PNG fetching for restaurants and branded entities using image_selector_tool or realistic fallback initials avatars.
Include sticky glass headers and sticky lower-third primary CTAs over scrolling content where applicable.
Integrate Socket.IO for real-time order tracking and simulated rider GPS movement.
Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt and safe areas are fully respected.
